decisions.statement: The documentation read is the `~/esoui` clone's `ESOUIDocumentation.txt`.
The opt-in manifest rather than the documentation decides which tokens are declared.
An enum a kept token names is kept.
An object above a kept object is kept.
A written file names the command that wrote that file and the API version that file was built from.
The checkout written into is named on the call.
A call naming no checkout writes into what `CODE_ROOT` names, else this repository.
The declarations land as one mechanical change rather than written here.
A file the checkout already has is left out of that change.
A type the documentation states that no declaration may carry refuses the call.
A run refusing over such a type writes nothing and names each such type.
No type reaches a declaration unjudged.
A name the checkout declares already is declared no second time here.
A run whose declarations carry such a name writes nothing and names those names.
The names weighed are the ones the pages carrying ambient types declare.
A name an interface or a namespace merges under is no such name.
The landing formats each body.
Nothing here runs a formatter.
A clone this workstation does not carry refuses the call.
Nothing here writes the clone.
The opt-in manifest naming which tokens are kept is in akasha.
A run that wrote before it threw says in its refusal what that run had written.

definition: the command writing the game's API declarations from the game's own documentation
